metric_boundaries.useful_bytes: receiver-counted in-order STREAM bytes read within the window, plus unique DATAGRAM payload bytes whose send time is within the window
metric_boundaries.object_completion: 1 MiB STREAM object, sender's first header byte to the receiver's FIN, for objects finishing within the window
metric_boundaries.datagram_useful_delivery: unique DATAGRAMs offered within the window and received, over those offered
metric_boundaries.competitor: the ordinary Reno flow's receiver-counted STREAM bytes within the window
